statement: Inferred across each ten-second stopped-Puck capture window, 0x42 counts correspond to 266.1,266.1,265.6 and 265.7 reports/s for idle,lizard,mouse and keyboard; reconnect window 199.0 reports/s includes disconnection. These are counts divided by window length, NOT measured packet cadence, polling rate, inter-arrival timing, jitter or guaranteed steady-state frequency. Cross-link: `steam-c6-sdl-sensor-4032us` is SDL's source-only 4032 us (~248/s) advertised sensor update, NOT a comparable physical input report rate; these Puck window totals do not constrain direct-wired 28de:1302 report/sensor cadence. Session 2 in `docs/steam-physical-capture-plan.md` separately measures wired packet interarrival timing.

applicability.revision: operator notes: July–August 2026; hardware revision unrecorded
